description: An SvGrid Base on a phone, in Svelte 5. Below 600px of its own width a grid view shows each record as a card with its name and the next four fields, in the view's filter and sort; a tap opens the record and + adds one. The view bar keeps its icons, and on a phone screen the opened record fills it. Switch between phone, tablet and desktop width.

faq.question: What decides when the phone layout starts?
faq.answer: The base's own width, not the window's: under 600px by default. Set phoneLayout to another number of pixels, true to always use it, or false to keep the grid.

faq.question: What do the cards show?
faq.answer: The record's primary field as the title, then the next four fields the view shows, in the view's order. Hide or move fields in the view and the cards follow.

faq.question: Do Kanban and calendar views change on a phone?
faq.answer: No. They are already made of cards and scroll as they do on a wider screen. Only grid views switch to the card list.
